answer: The registry compares attestation sets pairwise each epoch. A key that mirrors another's choices past 85 percent overlap for two epochs joins that cluster, and the cluster signs as one voice until 500 POA sits locked for ten epochs. Picking a different subset costs real work, since a shared node cache hands clones identical choices: each key has to sight its own beacons, twenty transactions at fifteen minutes apiece, so fifty clones owe 250 hours an epoch plus fifty separate state copies. A canyon gives any shout the same echo whether one person stood there or fifty.
